I have had these fruit trees for a few years now, and they give me better income at the market than cereals, so I want to take care of them. I will put some urea around the trees because the extension worker said it helps with fruiting, but I cannot afford too much for a plot this size. I also have cow manure from our animals that I will mix in, which costs me nothing and the trees seem to like it. My family and I will manage the weeding, spraying, and harvesting ourselves since the plot is small, and I do not have money to pay hired workers or build irrigation.
